title: Anointed Queens - official brand logo live across the site
notes: 1.3.0: official company logo artwork adopted - new brand mark in the site header (assets/logo.png), custom favicon (assets/icons/favicon.png) and PWA icons regenerated from the logo; social-share (og:image / twitter:image) paths fixed to the maskable icon; tokens bumped to ?v=4, service worker cache aq-v4

1.2.0: selling the in-house collection with real inventory - stock is decremented on every purchase and restored on refunds (Supabase sell_stock / restock_order RPCs, demo localStorage counter), low-stock 'Only X left' and sold-out states across shop, product detail, bag and checkout; add-to-bag and checkout refuse overselling; admin products screen gains quick +5/+10/+20 restock and low-stock warnings; e-commerce probe automates buy/refund/restock flows
